description: A role fact and a team fact learned in conversation; a direct question that repeats both subjects and an indirect one that shares no word with either. Limit: an answer that needs two memories needs both of them retrieved, and recall matches by word overlap, at most six memories per question. Failure means: needed-memory-missing names the fact that did not reach the model; a direct pass with an indirect failure shows retrieval, not the model, is the limit offline; live it also shows whether the model joins the two. Maintenance: no aged records, so on or off changes nothing; seeded distractors are younger than 94 days.
